reconciliation.reason: The packet separately specifies the retrieval agent's candidate and semantic filtering (L278-L313), the augmentation agent's strategy selection (L323-L348), and the review agent's quality gate and stopping loop (L357-L376). The older card merged these mechanisms and used a retired dimension label.

notes: The paper's LLMs are used as prompted agents around a trainable time-series encoder; no parameter-updated LLM module is contributed. The review output changes whether the augmentation search repeats, establishing feedback-driven execution. The current card's single module was split because the three agents are separately specified and independently reusable.

items.reason: The LLM picks strategies from a fixed augmentation library to produce semantically reliable positive views; library and objective are redesigned if the task changes (R3_1).
Top-K similarity then LLM semantic filtering builds reference context for a target series without embedding any task output requirement or validator; fails R3_1, meets R3_2.
Review verdict Correct/Error on augmented views decides whether the search restarts or stops; criterion is positive-view quality for augmentation (R3_1).

adjudication.summary: The merged record's three-way split is supported by separate method sections 3.2-3.4. Only retrieval moves to GTS; augmentation selection and review remain TSK.
